title: From Detection To Anticipation: Continuous Onset Forecasting For Stuttered Speech
abstract: arXiv:2610.19235v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic stuttering systems primarily detect dysfluencies after they have occurred, limiting their use for anticipatory intervention. We address this gap by formulating stuttering prediction as continuous causal time-to-event forecasting, where a model estimates the risk of an upcoming stuttering onset every 100 ms using only preceding speech. To support this task, we augment FluencyBank Timestamped for 36 speakers with manually reviewed repetitions, prolongations, and blocks, yielding 2,872 forecasting events. We then model the temporal evolution of frozen Whisper-large-v3 speech representations using a compact causal Conformer with 3.67M trainable parameters. The proposed approach achieves an AUROC of 0.63. Temporal analysis further shows that explicitly modeling preceding speech states outperforms simply increasing the static acoustic window, while a discrete-time survival formulation provides coherent forecasts from 300 ms to 1.5

translated_title: 从检测到预判：口吃言语的连续起始预测
translated_abstract: 自动口吃检测系统主要在言语不流畅发生之后才进行检测，这限制了其在预判性干预中的应用。我们通过将口吃预测构建为连续的因果性“时间-事件”预测任务来填补这一空白，在该任务中，模型仅利用先前的语音，每100毫秒估计一次即将发生的口吃起始的风险。为支持这一任务，我们对36名说话人的FluencyBank Timestamped数据集进行了扩充，加入了经人工审核的重复、延长和阻塞事件，共产生2,872个预测事件。随后，我们使用一个仅有367万可训练参数的紧凑因果Conformer对冻结的Whisper-large-v3语音表示的时间演化进行建模。所提出的方法达到了0.63的AUROC。时间分析进一步表明，显式建模先前语音状态优于简单增大静态声学窗口，而离散时间生存分析公式能够在300毫秒至1.5秒的范围内提供连贯一致的预测。
tldr: 该论文将口吃预测重新建模为连续因果时间-事件预测任务，仅利用先前语音每100毫秒预测口吃起始风险，并通过紧凑因果Conformer建模冻结Whisper语音表示的时间演化，实现了从“事后检测”到“事前预判”的转变。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates stuttering prediction as continuous causal time-to-event forecasting, using a compact causal Conformer to model the temporal evolution of frozen Whisper speech representations and estimate the risk of upcoming stuttering onset every 100 ms from preceding speech alone, shifting from post-hoc detection to anticipation.
